name: Succor and Smite
take: Two four-stage strings — Azure stance and Feather stance — and a metronome called Melody (cap 100) that her Basic Attacks SPEND as they deal damage. While the gauge holds, Azure hits pay her +20% Energy Regen; Azure stage 4 stamps a stack of Havoc Bane. Read that again: her basics don't build the resource, they drain it. The entire kit is a countdown to empty — and running dry is the plan, not the failure state.

name: Feather's Edge
take: Mid-string, the skill button swaps her stance and swings a Sword Stance Switch that counts as Heavy Attack DMG — and the combo cycle does NOT reset. Azure into Feather into Azure again, one unbroken sentence in two dialects, with a dodge-cancel window baked into every swap for 50 Melody. Two stances that never stop being one girl. The dance IS the damage type.

name: The Way of Ten Thousand Voices
take: The payoff for running the tank dry. When Melody hits zero, the skill transforms into Sword Stance Flow — a stance-crossing strike that counts as Heavy Attack DMG, refills all 100 Melody, banks an Azure Plume, and eats a Havoc Bane stack on the way through. Two Plumes banked lets her hold the attack button for the cyclone: a massive heavy that stamps 2 more Havoc Bane and rides Bated Breath — +160% Crit DMG on that one swing, once per 25s. Hold the note. Spend the storm. The 1M screenshots live HERE.

name: Hush of a Thousand Voices
take: A 1000% Havoc nuke that counts as Heavy Attack DMG, drinks every drop of Melody, and maxes the target's Havoc Bane stacks on impact. It also leaves Voice upon Voice behind: her next Sword Stance Flow summons a Shadow of Xuanling to echo the strike. The ult isn't a finisher — it's a debt collector. It slams every debuff to the ceiling and then the rest of the kit spends the ledger.

name: Skybound Feather
take: Tag in, deal Havoc DMG, bank an Azure Plume, stamp a Havoc Bane — three currencies in one entrance. Half a heavy-attack cyclone is already funded before her feet touch the ground. The feather lands before the sword does.

name: As the Wind Wills
take: She leaves with a 300% ATK parting cut and hands every other Resonator Tonal Switch for 20s: inflict Havoc Bane and your Havoc DMG gets Amplified 20%. It's a Havoc-team pact — she teaches the room her own language on the way out, and anyone who speaks it hits harder. Wind doesn't stop when the girl steps off stage.

name: Unbroken Vow
take: Havoc Bane isn't just a 2%-per-stack DEF shred — for HER it's a personal Amplifier. Stacks one through three each boost her damage 10% (up to 30%); stacks four through six are worth 12% apiece (another 36%). A fully-marked target at 6 stacks is eating both brackets at once. Every stamp from every skill in this codex was a deposit; this is the interest rate.

name: One Life, One Blade
take: The team clause. Her Liberation slams Havoc Bane to max on hit — and every time a TEAMMATE inflicts Havoc Bane, she gains Windbound (one per second, six cap). At six, she becomes One with the Wind: her next Sword Stance Flow summons Feather Release: Xuanling, which applies SIX Havoc Bane stacks in one motion. Run her with Havoc Bane friends and the debuff economy compounds itself. One life, one blade, one very crowded ledger.
